name: Percona Server for MongoDB
tagline: Drop-in MongoDB Community build with enterprise features like encryption, LDAP and hot backup.
description: Percona Server for MongoDB is a free, source-available rebuild of MongoDB Community Edition that adds features MongoDB reserves for Enterprise Advanced: data-at-rest encryption with KMIP/Vault, LDAP and Kerberos authentication, audit logging, an in-memory storage engine and hot backups. It tracks upstream closely (8.0.34-15 shipped in October 2026) and pairs with Percona Backup for MongoDB and the Percona Operator for Kubernetes. It is the usual choice for teams that want enterprise-grade self-hosted MongoDB without a MongoDB subscription.

pricing.notes: Free to download and run; Percona sells support and managed services.

scale.notes: Same replica-set and sharding architecture as upstream MongoDB.

strengths: Free data-at-rest encryption with HashiCorp Vault or KMIP key management
LDAP, Kerberos and AWS IAM authentication without an Enterprise licence
Audit logging and an in-memory storage engine included
Binary-compatible drop-in for MongoDB Community; same drivers and tools
Kubernetes operator and physical backup tooling from the same vendor
weaknesses: Lags upstream releases by days to weeks
No equivalent of Atlas Search or vector search features that MongoDB keeps proprietary
useCases: Self-hosted MongoDB in regulated environments needing encryption and audit
Replacing MongoDB Enterprise Advanced to cut licence costs
MongoDB on Kubernetes with an open operator
notIdealFor: Teams wanting a fully managed service
Workloads relying on Atlas-only search or vector features
